title: Field Guide: Tone Pairs Lab (16 Pitches & Sandhi)

words.Example (Chinese + Pinyin): 热烈欢迎新同学加入！(Rèliè huānyíng xīn tóngxué jiārù!) — Warmly welcome new classmates joining!
早餐吃一片烤面包和鸡蛋。(Zǎocān chī yí piàn kǎo miànbāo hé jīdàn.) — Eat a slice of toast and an egg for breakfast.
北京是中国的首都。(Běijīng shì Zhōngguó de shǒudū.) — Beijing is the capital of China.
这个句子其实非常简单。(Zhè ge jùzi qíshí fēicháng jiǎndān.) — This sentence is actually very simple.
掌握基础的汉语语法规则。(Zhǎowò jīchǔ de hànyǔ yǔfǎ guīzé.) — Master fundamental Chinese grammar rules.
学习书写常用汉字很实用。(Xuéxí shūxiě chángyòng hànzì hěn shíyòng.) — Learning to write common Chinese characters is very practical.
这两件衣服的质量完全一样。(Zhè liǎng jiàn yīfu de zhìliàng wánquán yí yàng.) — The quality of these two garments is completely identical.
他不是本地人，是从南方来的。(Tā bú shì běndì rén, shì cóng nánfāng lái de.) — He is not a local, he came from the south.

words.English Meaning: do not / don't want (不 Tone 2 sandhi)
words.Example (Chinese + Pinyin): 过马路时千万不要看手机。(Guò mǎlù shí qiānwàn bú yào kàn shǒujī.) — Definitely do not look at your phone when crossing the street.
周末大家一起去公园散步。(Zhōumò dàjiā yìqǐ qù gōngyuán sànbù.) — On weekends everyone goes walking in the park together.
走吧，我们一块儿去食堂。(Zǒu ba, wǒmen yíkuàir qù shítáng.) — Let's go, we'll head to the cafeteria together.
掌握四个声调对汉语听力很重要。(Zhǎowò sì ge shēngdiào duì hànyǔ tīnglì hěn zhòngyào.) — Mastering the four tones is essential for Chinese listening.
汉语中很多词的第二个字念轻声。(Hànyǔ zhōng hěn duō cí de dì èr ge zì niàn qīngshēng.) — In Chinese many words' second character is read in neutral tone.
第三声连续出现时会发生变调。(Dì sān shēng liánxù chūxiàn shí huì fāshēng biàndiào.) — When third tones appear consecutively, tone sandhi occurs.
老师在黑板上写了生词。(Lǎoshī zài hēibǎn shang xiě le shēngcí.) — The teacher wrote new words on the blackboard.
来一瓶冰镇啤酒。(Lái yì píng bīngzhèn píjiǔ.) — Bring a bottle of iced beer.
公园里有许多人在散步。(Gōngyuán lǐ yǒu xǔduō rén zài sànbù.) — There are many people walking in the park.
只要努力就能学好中文。(Zhǐyào nǔlì jiù néng xué hǎo zhōngwén.) — As long as you work hard you can master Chinese.
